scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "bun run dev:vite" "bun run dev:main" "wait-on dist/renderer/index.html dist/main/main.js dist/preload/preload.cjs && electron ."
scripts.build: bun run build:renderer && bun run build:main && bun run build:preload
scripts.build:preload: bun build src/preload/preload.ts --outfile dist/preload/preload.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron
